data.name: Rameeda
data.gender_notes: Rameeda is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is gentle, kind, and tender. Derived from the Arabic word 'Ra'ma', meaning compassionate and merciful. The name Rameeda carries the meaning “Graceful, gentle, tender” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Rameeda usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, gentle, tender and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a soul that is gentle, compassionate, and full of mercy.
data.etymology: Rameeda belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, gentle, tender.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rameeda total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: رميده
in_arabic.meaning: اسم بنت يعني المستقيمة السليمة من كل عيب أو شر
in_arabic.long_meaning: رميده اسم مشتق من الفعل رمى، ويعني رمي السهام أو الحجارة، ومن معانيه أيضًا التخلص من كل شر أو عيب، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: "وَرَمَتْهُ بِمَنّاً"، ويعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء ذات الدلالة العميقة في التراث الإسلامي.

in_urdu.name: رمیڈہ
in_urdu.meaning: ایک خوبصورت اور سلیس نام جس کا مطلب ہے بے عیب اور مستقیم
in_urdu.long_meaning: رمیڈہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جو کہ رمى فعل سے بنا ہے، جس کے معنی ہیں تیر یا پتھر پھینکنا، اور اس کا مطلب بھی ہے ہر قسم کی برائی یا نقص سے پاک، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے اور اکثر اس کا انتخاب اس کی خوبصورت معنی اور روحانی اہمیت کی وجہ سے کیا جاتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: रमीडा
in_hindi.meaning: एक सुंदर और सार्थक नाम जिसका अर्थ है निर्दोष और सीधी
in_hindi.long_meaning: रमीडा नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जो कि 'रमां' क्रिया से बना है, जिसका अर्थ है तीर या पत्थर फेंकना, और इसका अर्थ यह भी है कि हर तरह की बुराई या दोष से मुक्त, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में महत्व रखता है और अक्सर इसकी सुंदर अर्थ और आध्यात्मिक महत्व के कारण चुना जाता है.

in_pashto.name: رميده
in_pashto.meaning: د يوې نجلۍ نوم چې مانا يې وي بې ګناه او مستقيمه
in_pashto.long_meaning: رميده نوم د پښتو ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چي د رمى کلمې څخه جوړ شوی دی، چې مانا يې ده تیر یا ډبره ویشتل، او داسې مانا لري چې له هر ډول بدۍ یا ګناه څخه پاکه ده، دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو په دودیزو نومونو کې ځای لري او اکثراً د ښکلي معنی او روحاني ارزښت له امله غوره کیږي.

in_english.name: Rameeda
in_english.meaning: A beautiful and meaningful name for a girl, signifying straight and flawless
in_english.long_meaning: The name Rameeda originates from the Arabic root 'ramâ', which means to throw or cast, often interpreted as being free from defects or evil. In Islamic tradition, this name holds significant spiritual connotations, symbolizing purity and righteousness. Historically, it has been used across various Muslim cultures, cherished for its profound meaning and melodic pronunciation.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rameeda holds a significant cultural impact in the Islamic world as it represents the universal Muslim value of compassion and kindness towards others. It is a beautiful and cherished name for girls, implying a caring and nurturing nature. This name resonates with the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), who emphasized the importance of treating others with mercy and compassion.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Rameeda reflects the Divine Attribute of Allah (SWT) - Ar-Rahman (The Most Gracious) and Ar-Rahim (The Most Merciful). Embracing the name Rameeda means striving to embody the qualities of Allah's mercy and compassion towards all creation. By living a life grounded in the principles of kindness, gentleness, and tenderness, the person named Rameeda will be joining the noblest tradition of seeking to make this world a better place for all its inhabitants. The beautiful sounds and meanings of this name are not only a source of inspiration and joy for the bearer but a daily reminder of the merciful and compassionate nature of Allah and the consequences of emulating such traits in our actions. As the Holy Quran states, "And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a mercy to the worlds" (An-Nahl 11:11).
